title: What's New: Cloud Migration Tooling (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction and Overview of Three New Features
Custom Migration Tooling Platform for Developers
Demo and Details of BC14 Re-Implementation Tool
No-Code SQL Migration from Any Source
Demo and Conclusion of No-Code Migration

features.name: Custom Migration Tooling Platform
features.description: Developers can create their own migration tooling by writing an app that defines table mappings and setup data to migrate to Business Central from any SQL-based source using the existing migration platform.

features.name: Customer Migration Provider Interface
features.description: A new interface that provides extensibility for integrating custom migration tools with the cloud migration platform.

features.name: Business Central Version 14 Re-Implementation Tool
features.description: A custom migration tool that enables customers stuck on older on-premise Business Central and NAV versions to migrate core business data to the cloud, moving only a subset of data including master data, transactional data, opening balances and essential setup data.
caveats: System tables inaccessible by AL code cannot be migrated

features.name: No-Code SQL Data Migration
features.description: Ability to migrate from any SQL source without writing code by defining custom table mappings in the cloud migration setup and selecting individual tables to copy.
caveats: System tables inaccessible by AL code cannot be migrated
Highly controlled - only selected tables are copied

features.name: Table Mappings for Replication and Setup
features.description: Two kinds of table mappings: replication table mappings which define tables moved to Business Central, and setup table mappings which replicate once connected to on-premise database for use during setup step.

features.name: Configuration Export and Import for Migrations
features.description: Support for exporting and importing migration configurations so users do not need to configure mappings every time and can reuse configurations across tenants.
